releases.summary: The inbox: everything that needs a person, as one list. `GET /api/inbox` derives it from state on every call (a parked decoy response, a grant to accept, a decoy waiting for its merge or its arm, a pull request with a revision to approve or that the watcher gave up on, a failed job, an access finding, an available update, an incomplete setup), newest first, each item carrying the routes that act on it. Nothing is stored and nothing is marked read: an item leaves when the state changes. [docs/inbox.md](docs/inbox.md).

Demo mode: with `APP_MODE=demo` this image runs a public demo the way demo.beamreach.ai does, a synthetic account on the map beside a real one. [docs/demo.md](docs/demo.md) says how. The quickstart does not change. This release also carries 0.5.0 to 0.7.0, which were not released on their own: read their sections below, and their "After the update" notes apply to an install coming from 0.4.1.
